question: How do Crit DMG, Weakspot DMG, Attack %, Weapon DMG %, Elemental DMG %, Vulnerability and Final DMG combine on a single direct (bullet/melee) hit in Once Human? Sub-questions: (1) crit x weakspot additive or multiplicative; (2) Attack % vs Weapon DMG % one bucket or two factors; (3) does Elemental DMG % scale the weapon's own bullets; (4) hidden base crit / weakspot multiplier beyond the displayed stats; (5) vulnerability stacking and whether Final DMG is a separate factor.
verdict: Implement: hit = AttackFinal x (1 + sum WeaponDMG%) x (1 + sum ElementalDMG% of the weapon's own element, 0 for physical-bullet weapons) x (1 + sum DMGvsEnemyType%) x (1 + [crit] sum CritDMG% + [weakspot] sum WeakspotDMG%) x (1 + sum WeaponVulnerability% on target) x (1 + sum FinalDMG% whose scope covers this hit) x rangeFalloff x targetMitigation, where AttackFinal = weaponCardDMG(stars) x (1 + sum Attack%) (+ flat Attack). Expected hit = (1-CR) x hit_nocrit + CR x hit_crit, which under the additive model equals base x (1 + CR x CritDMG% + [weakspot] WeakspotDMG%). Sub-verdicts: (1) ADDITIVE: on a weakspot crit the multiplier is 1 + CritDMG% + WeakspotDMG% (one 'hit amplifier' bucket). This is the model used by every calculator that claims in-game observation (OHCalc spec 'observed', citing the r/OnceHumanOfficial 'detailed info about damages' test thread; meta-builds.net damage calculator; 0x91CEA55 ADR-002 Hit Amplifier bucket; OHMM computeCombinedCritWeakspotMultiplier; KremaOps). The calculators that multiply (thachvn0296, lReDragol, getzity, serhatalmez) are generic product-of-factors tools with no comments or test citations. No source with raw screenshot numbers for a crit-vs-weakspot test was reachable, so confidence is medium, and the multiplicative model must be a UI toggle. (2) TWO FACTORS: Attack % (calibration Attack bonus, Fast Gunner 'Attack +1%', Doombringer 'Attack +12%') modifies the Attack stat itself; Weapon DMG % (mods, sets, Cradle) is a separate multiplicative factor whose sources add together. Supported by the in-game tooltip definitions (Weapon DMG: 'Its base value is determined by Attack of the weapon'), by official proc texts ('60% of Attack as Weapon DMG'), by 0x91CEA55 (separate AttackPercent / WeaponDamage buckets), OHCalc and OHMM (base_attack = baseWeaponDMG*(1+atkPct); Weapon DMG % enters the additional-rate layer). Only KremaOps lumps them. (3) Elemental DMG % multiplies any damage instance tagged with that element: status/keyword procs always (Burn=Blaze, Frost Vortex=Frost, Power Surge=Shock, Unstable Bomber=Blast); the weapon's own bullets ONLY if the weapon card shows that element (Shrapnel 'element type is the same as the weapon's element'; the recovered Neox damage_formula has element_type_dam_add_rate_{physics,fire,ice,lightning,...} as a general term). For physical-bullet weapons it scales procs only (GameRant: 'Status and Elemental DMG does not affect bullet effects like Bounce, Shrapnel, and Fast Gunner'). Default: apply to procs; apply to bullets only when weapon.element != physical. (4) NO hidden base crit multiplier: crit hit = hit x (1 + displayed CritDMG%) and weakspot hit = hit x (1 + displayed WeakspotDMG%); every calculator and dataset stores the card values as the full bonus (e.g. AWS.338 crit 0.26 / weakspot 0.95), and the official 2.3.1 notes call the card stat 'Weakspot Multiplier' (65% / 75%). Anecdotal evidence (Steam: real weakspot hits ~10x a 'treated as weakspot' body hit; keengamer: 'Headshots deal 2.5 times base damage on human enemies') suggests enemy-specific weakspot ZONE multipliers exist on top of the player stat, so expose an 'enemy weakspot zone multiplier' input defaulting to 1.0. (5) Vulnerability sources of the same type add into ONE pool (Bull's Eye 8% + Vulnerability Amplifier +8% = 16%) and that pool is one multiplicative factor (1 + sum Vuln%); since the 2025-12-23 standardization Weapon Vulnerability applies to Weapon DMG hits and Status Vulnerability to Status DMG only. Final DMG ('X Final DMG +Y%', 'Ultimate DMG') is a separate multiplicative factor from the DMG-Factor/DMG-Coefficient pool (official/fandom proc formulas: Factor x (1 + DMG Factor Bonus) x (1 + Final DMG Bonus)); keyword-scoped Final DMG applies only to that keyword's hits.

alternativesToExpose: Crit x Weakspot MULTIPLICATIVE: weakspotCrit = base x (1 + CritDMG%) x (1 + WeakspotDMG%) (thachvn0296 OH-Calculator, lReDragol, getzity, serhatalmez, one Steam poster) instead of the default additive 1 + CritDMG% + WeakspotDMG%.

Single additive 'final damage add rate' pool (recovered Neox damage_formula as modelled by OHMM): Weapon DMG % + weapon-class DMG % + Elemental DMG % (incl. physics) + keyword DMG % + DMG vs enemy type % + DMG vs debuffed targets % all summed into ONE (1 + sum) factor, instead of separate multiplicative buckets.
Attack % and Weapon DMG % merged into one additive bucket (KremaOps model) instead of Attack x (1 + Weapon DMG %).

Elemental DMG % applied to the weapon's own bullets whenever the weapon has an element (default) vs. applied to status/keyword procs only (GameRant 2024 reading) vs. applied to all bullets regardless of element.
Vulnerability sources as separate multiplicative factors (prod (1 + v_i)) instead of one additive pool (1 + sum v_i); and Weapon vs Status Vulnerability split on/off.
Enemy weakspot ZONE multiplier input (default 1.0; e.g. 2.5x headshot vs human enemies per keengamer) applied on top of (1 + WeakspotDMG%), and an optional hidden base crit multiplier (default 0%).
'Ultimate DMG' as a bucket separate from 'Final DMG' (0x91CEA55 flag) vs. same bucket.

notes: Method: read formula code verbatim in every reachable GitHub calculator (lReDragol context_module.py, TeeReckzi/OHMM engine incl. its recovered Neox 'official formula graph', 0x91CEA55 simulator bucket-registry + ADRs + Knowledge Bible, thachvn0296 Sidebar.tsx, KremaOps index.html, TheDevilsKnock/OHCalc spec, getzity, serhatalmez, bramsey679 formulas.json); game sites were blocked so Steam/fandom/meta-builds/official statements come from search snippets (15 searches used). lReDragol's apply_dynamic_damage_bonuses and DPS code could not be read (file truncated by the fetch tool); its hit formula was fully quoted. No reachable source contained raw screenshot numbers for a crit-vs-weakspot test; the additive verdict rests on three independent groups that claim in-game observation (OHCalc/reddit 1ergsub, meta-builds.net, 0x91CEA55/OHMM) versus product-of-factors tools with no citations. Per-sub-question confidence: (1) medium; (2) medium-high; (3) low-medium (depends on weapon element tagging, which the planner's weapon data should carry); (4) medium that there is no hidden base crit multiplier, low on the existence/size of enemy weakspot zone multipliers; (5) medium. The OHMM Neox recovery is the only datamine-grade source: its terminal formula final_attack = max(base_attack x final_attack_additional_rate x final_attack_ignore_dam_rate x final_special_regulate_factor, 0) is marked high confidence, but its crit/weakspot branches are explicitly 'not yet recovered', so it cannot settle sub-question 1; it does, however, show that the game defines separate per-attack-type crit-damage add rates (attack_type_crit_dam_add_rate) and per-keyword weakspot add rates (keyword_proc_weak_dam_add_rate), and that element types are a general tag on every damage instance (physics/fire/ice/lightning/explode/impact...), which supports applying Elemental DMG % to element-tagged bullets. For the status-proc path (not asked, but needed for consistency): proc = Psi x factor x (1 + sum StatusDMG% + KeywordDMG% [+ DMG Coefficient, additive per 113 Test]) x (1 + ElementalDMG%) x (1 + FinalDMG%) x (1 + StatusVuln%), with crit/weakspot only where the proc text allows it.
